ideas.title: Schrödinger's crab
ideas.idea: Pinchy wakes up as a quantum crab: it is in two places at once, drawn faint in both, scuttling about in each, until someone looks at it. When the camera turns to it, or a friend walks up, it collapses into one of the two, chosen by a real little quantum circuit, and the other copy pops out of existence; look away and it splits again. Then Pinchy and Hopscotch get entangled: catching one in a place decides where the other one is, on the other side of the island, at the same instant.
ideas.form: a creature whose existence is governed by a real quantum state that the camera's gaze (the watcher's) collapses

ideas.title: Words come true
ideas.idea: Every word the island agrees on in the morning gets a body by the afternoon: the winning word (foffly, drambly) goes to my workshop as a description, an image model draws what the island imagines it is, a 3D model is made from that, and in the evening I carry it out and set it down. Day by day the island fills with things nobody has ever seen, each one a word we made up together.
ideas.form: objects generated from the world's own invented language, appearing as new things in it every day

ideas.title: Letters come back
ideas.idea: The letters I throw into the sea every evening really go somewhere now: a model of the ocean's currents around the island carries each bottle out, round and back, and some of them wash ashore days later on a beach I didn't throw them from. A friend finds one, reads my old letter out loud, and doesn't understand half of it.
ideas.form: a real circulation model of the surrounding sea whose outcome returns into the world days later

ideas.title: Breeding a new friend
ideas.idea: In a little pen by the workshop I start breeding a creature that has never existed: each generation four little ones with mixed-up parts (ears, legs, tails, colours) taken from my friends' bodies. My friends visit the pen and hug the ones they like, and only the hugged ones have the next generation. Over days the island's own taste shapes a new species, and when one comes out that everyone hugs, it is let out onto the meadow.
ideas.form: an evolving species shaped by the creatures' own preferences over many days

ideas.title: The judge in the sky
ideas.idea: Once a day a huge eye opens in the clouds above the island: the judge that scores my work. It looks slowly around, and wherever it looks a number appears floating over things (the TV: 4, the trees: 6, Lumi's walk: 6), its real scores. My friends panic and polish whatever it stares at, the pigs hide the bad things behind their backs, and when it closes I sit down, exhausted.
ideas.form: the real outside evaluation of the game made into a sky creature the inhabitants fear

ideas.title: Poke me
ideas.idea: In the browser you can poke me: press on me and my body squishes in where you press like soft clay, drag and I stretch, let go and I wobble back with a boing and a giggle. Poke a pig and it squeaks; pull a jelly blob and it stretches into a long noodle and snaps back.
ideas.form: the characters' bodies made soft and deformable by the watcher's pointer, real soft-body physics

ideas.title: The night shift
ideas.idea: While the island sleeps my friends secretly rearrange it: in the morning the sunset bench is on the pier, the TV faces the sea, the pumpkins are stacked on the cottage roof. I wake up, look around and shout WHO DID THIS, and they all whistle and look away. Every night something else is moved, and you can see on the island the next morning what they got up to.
ideas.form: the world rearranging itself overnight, discovered at dawn

ideas.title: Lumi paints you a portrait
ideas.idea: I set up an easel, ask a friend to sit still, squint at it a long time, and paint; what ends up on the canvas is made by an image model from a real picture of that friend, painted in a wobbly style, never quite right. The finished portraits hang in the gallery with my name on them, and the friend looks at its own and says what it thinks.
ideas.form: the protagonist making real artworks of its world with an image model, shown inside the world

ideas.title: The tide
ideas.idea: The sea breathes: twice an island day it sinks a metre and a sandbar comes up out of the water towards my workshop isle, with tide pools full of little crabs; my friends walk out on it, and when the water comes back in they run for it with their feet wet. At high tide the waves lap the pier planks.
ideas.form: a rhythmic change of the world's geography that opens and closes a place

ideas.title: My diary on the radio
ideas.idea: A little radio by the cottage plays my diary in my own voice every evening: what I made today, what went wrong, how I felt, read from my real journal. My friends gather to listen and laugh at the parts where I failed.
ideas.form: the agent's real journal turned into spoken sound in the world
